notes.title: Update Notes for v0.1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you’d get stuck on the padlock screen of the last puzzle.
[*] Movements are disabled while a new scene loads.
[*] The statue puzzle no longer resets when you leave the scene.
[*] Opening the inventory selects the last selected item slot instead of the left-most one.
[*] Added an indication when the electrical panel puzzle is solved.
[*] Prevented getting stuck on a screen if the object you’re looking at is for some reason not in range anymore.
[*] Loading screens after memories.
[*] Added up down indicators for the statue puzzle.
[*] The clock in the corridor kind of shows the time.
[*] You can’t access the electrical box from the porch anymore.
[*] Added dynamic audio for the band while they’re practising.
[*] Added barriers for going back into the house at certain points in the game.
[*] Background ambience for some levels.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The game waits for all dialogue choices to be shown before allowing input to prevent accidental choice selections.
[*] Standing too close to the birdcage no longer causes a dialogue error.
[*] Fixed a bug where you would phase through the front door and end up in the other screen.
[*] Choices are reselected after pausing and resuming.
[*] The quit button is disabled during dialogue and cutscenes that would break the game if you quit in the middle.
[*] Taxis and his bandmates now have animations when playing their instruments.
[*] Fixed the broken footstep sounds outside the factory.
[*] The dog breathes.
[*] Added books. For lore.
[*] Fixed Butter’s expressions and added more.
[*] Focusing on objects is easier now.
[*] Fixed text wrapping issues.
[*] Added a bird.
[*] Taking a photo in the basement after the lights are fixed no longer turns off the lights.
[*] You cannot fall into the void by jumping from the top of the staircase anymore.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.1.1
notes.content:

[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.2.1
notes.content:

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.2.0
notes.content:
Phase two of beta testing begins!
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Butter give puzzles hints now!
[*] Music only stops during conversations instead of every time dialogue.
[*] More consistent UI.
[*] Using enter to submit is disabled if the enter key is used in a rebind.
[*] Disabled inventory while dialogue is playing.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused cameras to not switch in the garden.
[*] Added more key prompts at the beginning.
[*] Fixed camera overshooting at scene borders.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for v0.1.5
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Character voices!
[*] More finished backgrounds. We’re getting there.
[*] Controls are rebindable through the options menu now.
[*] You can press enter or spacebar instead of E while in the main menu.
[*] Interacting with certain objects no longer causes the player to freeze.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.1.4
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the main menu buttons after quitting the game.
[*] Added the pink diamond pointer to the pause and options menu as well.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.1.3
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Repositioned the “Back” button prompt so it can be seen on more screen ratios.
[*] Changed the button selection GUI.
[*] Music box digits look legit now.
[*] Added continue indicators for more dialogue boxes.
[*] You can see the outside though the window in the first room.
[*] You can now actually take a photo of Taxis during his performance.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.1.2
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Quitting while a memory is playing no longer causes an infinite loop.
[*] Modified the camera GUI and added some beeps and boops.
[*] Added a button for resetting the game in the options menu (from the main menu)
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.1.1
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Brought the gate pillar in the driveway to the foreground.
[*] Camera storage is now unlimited.
[*] Changed bookmark so it stays after reloading the scene.
[*] Camera viewfinder does not get funky on non-16:9 displays anymore.
[*] Fixed more aspect ratio issues in memory cutscenes.
[*] Pausing the game now pauses audio as well.
[*] Maze progress is saved.
[*] Book order is saved.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]
